observations.summary: Houthis publicly claimed attacks on a Saudi East-West pipeline pumping station, a Yanbu oil facility and a Riyadh Aramco building, without stating attack dates. Saudi-led coalition separately reported intercepting two Houthi drones, one near Riyadh and another in Eastern Province. No independent confirmation of new pipeline damage or throughput loss. Claim is significant because the pipeline bypasses Hormuz disruption; intercepted drones do not independently verify claimed pipeline strikes.
observations.title: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi East-West oil pipeline and Yanbu
